id.meaning: Identifier from the accept route path. A pending house-link-up enters admission; another pending row follows the existing generic accept action.

schema.meaning: When present and non-null, the old request's schema must equal caduceus.notifications.v1.

names.meaning: Unique .home.arpa names; absent or null uses the candidate's names. Each label is 1–63 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or hyphens, with no leading or trailing hyphen.

dry_run.meaning: Only the literal true selects the portal-admit plan instead of the write. All other JSON values, including null, proceed as non-dry-run; the existing notification schema declares boolean or null.

schema.meaning: Local success and refusal use caduceus.notifications.v1. A failed portal-admit receipt is passed through whole, including its own schema if present.

ok.meaning: Success or refusal of the composite operation.

id.meaning: Accepted ledger row ID on successful mutation.

state.meaning: Accepted after a successful house-link-up admission; another notification kind follows notify act and may return its resulting or prior state.

staff.meaning: The portal-admit receipt on successful or incomplete house-link-up convergence, or the notify-act receipt for another notification kind; a failed portal-admit receipt instead becomes the whole top-level return.

dry_run.meaning: True on a locally planned admission; a passed-through portal-admit refusal may report false.

attempted.meaning: The planned admission has not been attempted.

argv.meaning: The planned portal-admit argument vector on dry run.

child_portals.meaning: The child-portal plan on dry run; actual child results are nested in staff on success.

primitive.meaning: Portal-admit primitive on a passed-through receipt.

role.meaning: Appliance profile on a passed-through portal-admit receipt.

changed.meaning: Change reported by a passed-through portal-admit receipt, including partial effects.

state_generation.meaning: Certificate state generation from a passed-through receipt.

client_reinstall_required.meaning: Trust reinstall posture from a passed-through receipt.

generation.meaning: Certificate commit generation on a passed-through receipt.

children.meaning: Composition children returned by a passed-through receipt.

failed_child.meaning: First failed child from a passed-through receipt.

child_signal.meaning: Child signal or exception text from a passed-through receipt.

held_generation.meaning: Held generation on a passed-through receipt.

hestia_seat.meaning: Hestia seat status from a passed-through receipt.

skipped_fields.meaning: Skipped Hestia fields from a passed-through receipt.

served_fields.meaning: Served field names from a passed-through receipt.

proof.meaning: Evidence named in a passed-through receipt.

error.meaning: An error value carried by a passed-through receipt; it is not renamed firstMissingSignal.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. The returned portal-admit receipt is passed through whole and can carry firstMissingSignal of any JSON type or open text; its separate error field is not renamed.
